effects.effect: Activate 1 of these effects. ● Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; change that target's battle position. ● Tribute 1 monster, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; take control of that target until the End Phase.
effects.window: Whenever a Quick-Play Spell can be activated (from the hand during your turn, or Set on either player's turn after the turn it was Set)
